definitions.bearerAuth.description: "Provide a bearer token in the Authorization header, e.g.
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Obtain one via the `oauth` or
`oauthDistrict` flows below or via the Clever UI.
"

definitions.oauth.description: "Redirect the user to authorizationUrl, then exchange the returned
code at tokenUrl (via HTTP Basic Auth with your client ID/secret)
for an access token. Issues an SSO bearer token, scoped to the
signed-in user. Does not provide full Data API/roster access.
"

definitions.oauthDistrict.description: "Authenticate directly against tokenUrl via HTTP Basic Auth with
your app's client ID/secret to get an access token. Add a
`district=<id>` query param to scope the token to that district.
Issues a district-app token in access_code field, scoped to that district's shared data.
"
